spots.name: Gerald J. Ford Stadium
spots.summary: Gerald J. Ford Stadium is a stadium in Dallas, Texas. The stadium is owned by Southern Methodist University (SMU) and is used primarily for games played by the SMU Mustangs football team.

spots.name: Dallas Hall

spots.summary: The Mustangs, representing Southern Methodist University as members of the Atlantic Coast Conference, are the most prominent college sports program on the Dallas side of the Metroplex.
